description: Defines reference counting base classes and utilities for thread-safe and non-thread-safe reference counting, including classes like RefCountedBase, RefCountedThreadSafeBase, and related traits and wrappers.

classes.name: RefCountedBase
classes.description: Base class for reference counting, providing AddRef and Release methods, with support for thread-unsafe reference counting.

classes.name: RefCountedThreadSafeBase
classes.description: Thread-safe base class for reference counting, using atomic operations for AddRef and Release.

classes.name: ScopedAllowCrossThreadRefCountAccess
classes.description: Disables thread-safety checks for cross-thread reference count access in specific cases.

classes.name: RefCounted
classes.description: Template class for non-thread-safe reference counted objects.

classes.name: RefCountedThreadSafe
classes.description: Template class for thread-safe reference counted objects.

classes.name: RefCountedData
classes.description: Thread-safe wrapper for data to be used with scoped_refptr.

methods.name: HasOneRef
methods.description: Checks if the reference count is exactly one.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: IsOnValidSequence
methods.description: Checks if the object is being accessed on a valid sequence (thread).
